name: Molokaʻi Hoe
text: The men's world championship of outrigger canoe racing, across the Kaʻiwi Channel to Waikīkī. Run by the Oahu Hawaiian Canoe Racing Association since 1952.

name: Na Wahine O Ke Kai
text: The women's world championship: 41 miles from Hale O Lono on Molokaʻi across the Kaʻiwi Channel to Waikīkī.

name: Queen Liliʻuokalani Canoe Race
text: The world's largest outrigger canoe race, held each September on the Big Island.

name: Na Pali Challenge
text: A 37-mile mixed water-change race down the Na Pali Coast, presented by the Kauaʻi Outrigger Association.

name: Pailolo Challenge
text: A channel crossing race across the Pailolo Channel, one of the windiest in Hawaiʻi.

name: Catalina Crossing
text: The US Outrigger Championships, run by the Southern California Outrigger Racing Association each September.
